title: LTER-MareChiara Data Processing Workflow
text: LTER-MareChiara station (40°81’N, 14°25’E) monitoring zooplankton communities since 1984 part Long-Term Ecological Research network. represents one longest continuous time series Mediterranean Sea. Key Dataset Characteristics: - Temporal Coverage: 1984-2024 (40 years) - Total Samples: 1,506 - Taxonomic Diversity: 148 copepod species + 61 taxa - Sampling Method: Vertical tows (0-50m depth) - Mesh Size: 200 μm - Location: Gulf Naples, Tyrrhenian Sea, Western Mediterranean

title: Convert legacy LTER-MareChiara zooplankton data to Darwin Core format — format_to_dc
text: Input Data Format: function expects preprocessed legacy data parquet format following structure: eventID: Unique sampling event identifier (e.g., "mc_1", "mc_2") eventDate: Sampling date Date format (YYYY-MM-DD) scientificName: Full scientific name WoRMS validation lsid: WoRMS Life Science Identifier URN (e.g., "urn:lsid:marinespecies.org:taxname:104251") Abundance: Abundance measurement (ind/m³) lifeStage: Life stage code ("f" = female, "m" = male, "j" = juvenile, "fm" = sexes, "fmj" = stages) Current Implementation: Merges legacy data (1984-2020 hot storage) ongoing survey landings (2021-present automation bucket) converts combined dataset Darwin Core format. Output uploaded versioned RDS SharePoint. Darwin Core Conversion: function creates three Darwin Core extension tables following OBIS (Ocean Biodiversity Information System) standards: Event Extension: Core table sampling event metadata including temporal (eventDate) spatial information (decimalLatitude, decimalLongitude, locality, waterBody, depth ranges, samplingProtocol) Occurrence Extension: Links Event via eventID, contains species occurrences scientificName, scientificNameID (WoRMS LSID), occurrenceStatus (present/absent based Abundance > 0) eMoF Extension: Extended Measurement Fact table linked via occurrenceID, containing quantitative measurements standardized vocabulary terms BODC NERC Vocabulary Server (NVS): Individual counts NERC P06 units (ind/m³) Sex information (P01/ENTSEX01) S10 controlled vocabulary Life stage information (P01/LSTAGE01) S11 controlled vocabulary Geographic Information: LTER-MareChiara station coordinates automatically assigned events: Latitude: 40.81°N Longitude: 14.25°E Locality: LTER-MareChiara station Water Body: Mediterranean Sea (Gulf Naples, Tyrrhenian Sea) Depth range: 0-50 meters (vertical tow) Country: Italy (Campania region) Data Standards: Taxonomic identifiers: WoRMS LSIDs Measurement vocabulary: BODC NERC Vocabulary Server (NVS) Format: Darwin Core Archive structure Compliance: OBIS schema EMODnet Biology requirements
